rules.rationale: Base equation defining the nonNegativeVals domain predicate on the empty value sequence.
Structural recurrence defining nonNegativeVals for an integer head and the remaining sequence.
Fallback equation completing the definition of nonNegativeVals by rejecting non-integer-headed sequences.
Guarded defining equation for the next repetition count when the current value equals the previous value.
Complementary guarded defining equation that resets the repetition count when the values differ.
Base equation defining the final previous value after scanning an empty suffix.
Structural recurrence defining the final previous value by advancing through the sequence.
Base equation defining the final repetition count after scanning an empty suffix.
Structural recurrence defining the final repetition count using nextRepeated on each sequence element.
Base equation defining the final loop value after scanning an empty suffix.
Structural recurrence defining the final loop value by retaining the last scanned element.
Base equation defining duplicateOK as true when no values remain to be scanned.
Structural recurrence defining duplicateOK by checking the next run count and descending on the tail.
Defining equation for the accumulated duplicate-scan result as the prior Boolean conjoined with duplicateOK.
Guarded equation defining the named contract predicate from sortVS equality and the duplicate-scan summary.
